title: automation: tenant RBAC bootstrap for Private installer (helm + terraform) and upgrade tooling
author: Jordan Kim
description: Motivation: Automate tenant RBAC bootstrap for Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) so the installer (helm + terraform) and upgrade/rollback tooling can provision tenant-scoped roles and bindings without manual intervention. What this PR does: adds Helm templates to seed tenant Role and RoleBinding resources during private-installer runs, introduces a terraform module output contract for initial admin principals, implements an idempotent 'rbac-bootstrap' KubernetesJob used by the installer to apply policies, and provides upgrade hooks to reconcile RBAC after chart upgrades. Includes new policy YAML templates, small controller helper to render tenant isolation variants, and scripts used by the private-installer to trigger bootstrap and verify idempotence. How tested: unit tests for YAML template rendering and schema validation; integration run in staging (perf-canary private cluster) with repeated install/upgrade cycles to validate idempotence and rollback; manual verification with customer-like tenant manifests. Rollout: gated feature-flag in installer, canary to three private customers, monitor RBAC reconciliation metrics/alerts, full rollout after 2 successful canaries. Rollback: helm rollback will revert chart templates; terraform state can be used to destroy bootstrap resources if necessary; bootstrap is idempotent so re-running previous release is safe. Impact: removes manual RBAC post-install steps and reduces setup time for private deployments; backwards compatible for existing clusters. See linked Linear ENG-4823 and ticket SUP-2211 for support follow-ups.
commits: 1) feat(rbac): add helm templates for tenant Role/RoleBinding and installer bootstrap job; 2) feat(terraform): expose initial_admin_principals output and docs; 3) chore(tests): add unit tests for template renderer + schema; 4) fix(ci): adjust yamllint rules for policy yamls

Ethan Cole: Approved after integration canary report; left a minor nit about terraform output name consistency which was addressed.
Author (Jordan Kim): Thanks everyone; added docs, updated release notes, and validated canary cluster results.
ci_checks: Initial CI: lint failed (policy yaml schema anchor); author updated templates and re-ran. Unit tests: all passing. Integration e2e (staging canary): passed on 2/2 runs. Security scan: no risky permissions detected. Final CI status: pass.

release_notes: Automated tenant RBAC bootstrap for Private installer (helm + terraform); adds idempotent rbac-bootstrap job and installer hooks; terraform module exposes initial_admin_principals output for automated provisioning; rollout behind feature flag; reduces manual post-install RBAC steps and speeds up private deployment setup.
notes_for_ops: Monitoring: watch rbac.bootstrap.job.duration, policy.apply.errors, and tenant-isolation.reconcile.count. Suggested canary metrics: successful-bootstrap-runs, duplicate-bindings-detected. Rollback steps: helm rollback <release> or run installer with feature-flag disabled and rerun terraform to remove bootstrap outputs.
